name: cortico-world-sound-del
description: Mute Windows playback from Coopanion's existing push-to-talk shortcut and restore it afterward. Requires the built-in desktop-pet voice module.

zh.description:
按下 Coopanion 原收音快捷键时静音播放设备，收音结束后恢复。

- 不修改主程序、不更换快捷键、不模拟按键。
- 保留原有静音状态与手动覆盖，异常时保留恢复记录。
- Windows x64；依赖内置 desktop-pet 语音模块的本机状态接口。

第三方扩展。静音覆盖所有活动播放设备，包括 Coopanion 自己的声音；不是麦克风降噪。已在作者的环境试用，不保证所有驱动和高负载下零延迟。

en.description:
Mute playback from Coopanion's existing push-to-talk shortcut and restore it when recording ends.

- No host patch, shortcut remapping or injected input.
- Preserve existing mute and detected manual overrides; retain recovery records on failure.
- Windows x64; requires the built-in desktop-pet voice module's local state interface.

Third-party extension. Mutes all active playback endpoints, including Coopanion itself; not microphone noise cancellation. Manually tried on the author's setup, not a zero-latency guarantee across drivers and system loads.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:ts
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:native && npm run test:integration
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:extension && npm run verify:package
